description: Real-World Dataset Collection for Drive-by and Direct Monitoring of Railway Bridges Time-Synchronized On-Board and Structure-Side Records from Three High-Speed Train Types and Five Bridges including Shaker Tests is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Maximilian Michael Rupp, Steven Robert Lorenzen (Technische Universität Darmstadt). This dataset is a unique collection of full-scale measurements from five railway bridges under regular service conditions. The bridges were crossed by three different high-speed train types (ICE 4, ICE TD and ICE L). Forced-vibration (shaker) tests complement the train crossing data. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
